input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include cache utils, check login annotation, cors filter. Core business data revolves around Group, GroupMsgDao, GroupUserDao, UserFriendAskDao.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a API Consumer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage cache utils operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
